nodes.long_description:
It means absolutely nothing if you don't have that swing, jab, or the finesse of that left hook! Enter Beat the Beats – the boxing rhythm VR game where you throw punches but you can’t fight the rhythm. Use actual boxing moves like crosses, rolls and uppercuts to blast your way through a series of electrifying musical levels and climb the leaderboards.

Unlock new genres, complete daily challenges, and build your skill in rhythm boxing. For the serious competitor, there’s also an extra challenging B-Side for each track that will make you sweat to master.

Beat the Beats is a fun and fresh boxing experience for both greenhorns and champions!



Features:
- Learn natural boxing moves like jab, hook, uppercut, rolls and block!
- Get moving with a workout that doesn’t feel like work! 
- Compare your skills in global leaderboards and beat daily challenges!
- 35 handpicked tracks from different electronic music genres in over 60+ levels!
- Unlock new genres and B-sides!
- Keep things fresh with daily mixes!
- A fun, immersive experience with plenty of depth for the dedicated rhythm champion!
nodes.short_description: Beat the Beats is an electric mix of rhythm and boxing game! Use actual boxing-style punches to pound your way through musical arcade levels in hypnotic VR. Get pumped, get moving and beat the beats!

nodes.change_log:
Beat the Beats Demo 1.0.0.85: October Update

NEW FINAL LEVEL!
Now the last level of the demo is Nu Disco from our friend Alejandro Del Pozo. Albums unlock as you play: Get Over It after you complete 2 songs, and Nu Disco after 3 (tutorial lessons don't count).

NEW MODIFIERS!
You'll find both in Gameplay Options, alongside the other modifiers. Both are translated into every supported language.
- Slower Song: the whole song, music and targets together, plays 10% slower. Use it to learn a tough song, warm up, or simply play at a calmer pace. Scores with it on are reduced by 10%.
- Hide Hits Score: hides the floating score numbers that pop up each time you hit a target, for a cleaner view so you can focus on the rhythm. No score penalty.

GAMEPLAY CHANGES
- Easier grades: the score needed for each grade is lower on every demo song:
  - S: 90% (was 94%)
  - A: 85% (was 89%)
  - B: 65% (was 80%)
- Targets fit your height: how far away elements appear now adjusts to your arm reach, so taller and shorter players both get comfortable punches.
- Your best grade is safe: playing a song without modifiers no longer replaces a better grade you already earned.

BUG FIXES AND MISC
- Dodges: balanced to be easier to avoid with certain movements.
- Pause: segment triangles, ghost hand blockers and block trails no longer stay visible while paused.
- The locked cage in the main menu can no longer be hit again after it breaks.
- If you leave the LIV tablet too far away, it now moves back within reach.
- Health recovered from segments now matches its on-screen effect.
- Fixed issue where modifier icons could be placed in the wrong place.
- The in-game streak counter is now translated, and Traditional Chinese text renders better.
- The end-of-demo showcase now shows all album covers and says the full game is Out now! (it used to say "Wishlist now!").
- The credits were updated.
